name: LostAndFoundRegister
tagline: Hotel lost property done properly – log, match, secure, return or dispose, all in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete lost & found module for hotels, resorts and stores: log found items and guest lost reports in one register, see scored matches between them, keep valuables in secure storage, follow retention periods by category, hand ID documents to the police, contact owners with follow-up reminders, arrange returns by collection or courier with an ID check and a witness for high-value items, and dispose or donate after retention – with front desk, coordinator and duty manager roles. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Found items and guest lost reports in one register with LF-/LR- references
Match scoring (category, words, colour, room, guest, date window) with link & contact
Secure storage rule for valuables, cash, cards, documents and medication
Retention by category: standard, high value & electronics, perishable
ID documents flagged for the police / consulate
Returns by collection, courier or post with tracking and fees
Photo ID check and witness for high-value hand-overs
Disposal / donation after retention with method and witness
Roles: front desk / housekeeping, coordinator, duty manager
Undo, CSV export and printable release receipt
Power Fx outputs and events (ReceiptText, SummaryJson)
